Test Case Name: Verify Processing Status Tile Visibility on Dashboard
Description: Verify that the new tile named "Processing status" (Bearbeitungsstatus) is displayed on the dashboard
Pre-conditions: User is logged in with valid credentials and has access to dashboard
Step Description: Launch the application and login with valid credentials
Expected Result: User is logged in successfully

Step Description: Navigate to the dashboard page
Expected Result: Dashboard page loads completely

Step Description: Scan the dashboard for available tiles
Expected Result: All dashboard tiles are visible

Step Description: Locate the "Processing status" (Bearbeitungsstatus) tile
Expected Result: New tile named "Processing status" is present on the dashboard

Step Description: Verify the tile displays summary information
Expected Result: Tile shows overview of actions currently being processed

Test Case Name: Verify Processing Status Tile Shows Correct Action Statuses
Description: Verify that the tile displays status of actions: saved - for approval - and approved
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and actions exist in various statuses (saved - for approval - approved)
Step Description: Navigate to the dashboard page
Expected Result: Dashboard page loads successfully

Step Description: Locate the "Processing status" tile on dashboard
Expected Result: Tile is visible and accessible

Step Description: Verify "Saved" status is displayed on the tile
Expected Result: Saved status count/indicator is shown

Step Description: Verify "For Approval" status is displayed on the tile
Expected Result: For approval status count/indicator is shown

Step Description: Verify "Approved" status is displayed on the tile
Expected Result: Approved status count/indicator is shown

Step Description: Verify all three statuses are clearly visible and distinguishable
Expected Result: All action statuses are displayed with clear differentiation

Test Case Name: Verify Pop-up Display When Processing Status Tile is Activated
Description: Verify that activating the tile opens a pop-up with details of actions being processed
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and Processing status tile is visible on dashboard
Step Description: Navigate to the dashboard page
Expected Result: Dashboard page loads successfully

Step Description: Locate the "Processing status" tile
Expected Result: Tile is visible on dashboard

Step Description: Click/Activate the "Processing status" tile
Expected Result: Click action is registered

Step Description: Verify a pop-up window appears
Expected Result: Pop-up is displayed on screen

Step Description: Verify pop-up contains list of actions being processed
Expected Result: Actions with processing status details are shown in the pop-up

Step Description: Verify each action shows its current status (saved/for approval/approved)
Expected Result: Status details are visible for each listed action

Step Description: Verify pop-up can be closed
Expected Result: Pop-up closes and returns to dashboard view

Test Case Name: Verify Navigation from Pop-up to Original Mask for Release Process
Description: Verify users can select an area in the pop-up to navigate to the original mask for continuing the release process
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and Processing status pop-up is open with actions listed
Step Description: Open the Processing status tile pop-up from dashboard
Expected Result: Pop-up displays with list of actions

Step Description: Identify the selectable areas within the pop-up
Expected Result: Clickable/selectable areas are visible for each action

Step Description: Click on a selectable action/area in the pop-up
Expected Result: Selection is registered

Step Description: Verify navigation to the original mask occurs
Expected Result: User is redirected to the original mask/form for the selected action

Step Description: Verify the original mask displays the action details
Expected Result: Correct action data is loaded in the mask

Step Description: Verify user can continue the release process from the mask
Expected Result: Release process functionality is accessible and operational

Pre-conditions: User is logged in and system has multiple actions in processing state
Step Description: Clear browser cache and cookies
Expected Result: Cache is cleared

Step Description: Navigate to the dashboard page
Expected Result: Dashboard begins loading

Step Description: Measure the time for Processing status tile to load
Expected Result: Tile loads without significant delay (performance acceptable - specific threshold not specified)

Step Description: Click on the Processing status tile to open pop-up
Expected Result: Pop-up loading is initiated

Step Description: Measure the time for pop-up data to load
Expected Result: Pop-up displays data without noticeable performance degradation

Step Description: Verify data is retrieved from backend endpoint efficiently
Expected Result: No timeout errors or excessive loading times occur

Step Description: Verify tile and pop-up remain responsive with large data sets
Expected Result: System handles multiple pending actions without freezing or lag
